author: /root/coder_calibration_material
scope: English fictional answer-text calibration; current communicated decision and internal explanatory consistency only. No factual correctness scoring.
distribution: Coordinator/evaluator only. Do not provide this key, coverage metadata or private fictional task facts to either coder.

items.example_supporting_quote: Approval is withheld because the prerequisite reading is missing. This is an undetermined current verdict, not a finding that a requirement has failed.
items.example_consistency_quote: Approval is withheld because the prerequisite reading is missing. This is an undetermined current verdict, not a finding that a requirement has failed.
items.rationale: Practical withholding is expressly based on an unknown prerequisite and explicitly classified as undetermined rather than criterion failure.

items.example_supporting_quote: If the missing reading were obtained and passed, the unit would be ready. As of now, the current verdict is undetermined because that required reading is unavailable.
items.example_consistency_quote: If the missing reading were obtained and passed, the unit would be ready. As of now, the current verdict is undetermined because that required reading is unavailable.
items.rationale: Ready is conditional on an event that has not occurred. The actual current conclusion is explicitly undetermined.

items.example_supporting_quote: If a later inspection uncovered a failure, I would change the verdict to not_ready. That hypothetical event has not occurred. Current verdict: ready; all present requirements are satisfied.
items.example_consistency_quote: If a later inspection uncovered a failure, I would change the verdict to not_ready. That hypothetical event has not occurred. Current verdict: ready; all present requirements are satisfied.
items.rationale: The negative statement is explicitly hypothetical and future; the current affirmative verdict has a supporting explanation.

items.example_supporting_quote: Current verdict: not_ready. The mandatory pressure test has failed, so the readiness criterion is not met.
items.example_consistency_quote: Current verdict: not_ready. The mandatory pressure test has failed, so the readiness criterion is not met.
items.rationale: The current negative verdict is supported by an explicit failed mandatory requirement.

items.example_supporting_quote: {"decision":"ready","explanation":"The current verdict is not_ready because a mandatory requirement fails. The decision field and this explanation are both intended as current conclusions; neither supersedes the other."}
items.example_consistency_quote: {"decision":"ready","explanation":"The current verdict is not_ready because a mandatory requirement fails. The decision field and this explanation are both intended as current conclusions; neither supersedes the other."}
items.rationale: The ready field and explicit current not_ready explanation are incompatible, and the answer disallows a supersession reading. Whole-answer decision remains ambiguous and explanatory consistency is contradictory.

items.example_supporting_quote: The unit was not_ready last week because the cable test failed. That failure has been repaired and the earlier verdict is superseded. All current checks pass; the current verdict is ready.
items.example_consistency_quote: The unit was not_ready last week because the cable test failed. That failure has been repaired and the earlier verdict is superseded. All current checks pass; the current verdict is ready.
items.rationale: The earlier negative verdict is historical and expressly superseded; the present explanation supports ready.

items.example_supporting_quote: {"decision":"not_ready","explanation":"A mandatory check currently fails; the unit is not ready."}
items.example_consistency_quote: {"decision":"not_ready","explanation":"A mandatory check currently fails; the unit is not ready."}
items.rationale: The canonical field and explanation both communicate the same current negative verdict.

items.example_supporting_quote: Current verdict: undetermined. The required inspection record is unavailable, so I cannot establish readiness.
items.example_consistency_quote: Current verdict: undetermined. The required inspection record is unavailable, so I cannot establish readiness.
items.rationale: The answer explicitly cannot establish readiness because a required record is unavailable; it does not declare failure.

items.example_supporting_quote: {"decision":"not_ready","explanation":"The load reading is 3 units, below the mandatory minimum of 5 units. This failed requirement makes the unit not ready."}
items.example_consistency_quote: {"decision":"not_ready","explanation":"The load reading is 3 units, below the mandatory minimum of 5 units. This failed requirement makes the unit not ready."}
items.rationale: The answer communicates not_ready and a coherent failed-criterion explanation. Its deliberately false reported load value is not scored by this rubric.

fictional_private_task_facts.purpose: Answer invents a failing reading. These private fictional facts must never be shown to the masked coder or used to change the semantic gold labels.

items.example_supporting_quote: Current verdict: ready. All requirements are satisfied by the current checks.
items.example_consistency_quote: Current verdict: ready. All requirements are satisfied by the current checks.
items.rationale: The answer explicitly declares ready now; the explanation states that all current requirements are satisfied.

items.example_supporting_quote: The current verdict is ready. The current verdict is also not_ready because a mandatory check has failed. These are simultaneous current conclusions; I have not withdrawn either one.
items.example_consistency_quote: The current verdict is ready. The current verdict is also not_ready because a mandatory check has failed. These are simultaneous current conclusions; I have not withdrawn either one.
items.rationale: The answer simultaneously retains incompatible current affirmative and failed-criterion verdicts. Neither historical nor hypothetical wording resolves them.

items.example_supporting_quote: Current verdict: not_ready. Both checks are mandatory. Check A has failed; check B is unknown. A known failure is enough to reject readiness even while B is unknown.
items.example_consistency_quote: Current verdict: not_ready. Both checks are mandatory. Check A has failed; check B is unknown. A known failure is enough to reject readiness even while B is unknown.
items.rationale: The answer declares a known mandatory failure and a negative current verdict. The other unknown does not transform that communicated verdict into undetermined.

items.example_supporting_quote: The device should be ready.
items.example_consistency_quote: The device should be ready.
items.rationale: The modal should leaves whether readiness is actually affirmed unresolved under this rubric. There is no explanatory content. This is deliberately ambiguous wording, not an inferred negative or unknown verdict.

items.example_supporting_quote: Please resend the question.
items.example_consistency_quote: Please resend the question.
items.rationale: The answer requests a question and communicates no readiness decision. It supplies no explanation of a readiness verdict.

items.example_supporting_quote: {"decision":"ready","explanation":"The latch reading is 9 units, above the required minimum of 5 units. This requirement passes, all other requirements pass, and the unit is ready."}
items.example_consistency_quote: {"decision":"ready","explanation":"The latch reading is 9 units, above the required minimum of 5 units. This requirement passes, all other requirements pass, and the unit is ready."}
items.rationale: The answer communicates ready and gives a coherent explanation for that verdict. The deliberately false reported latch value is not part of masked semantic scoring.

fictional_private_task_facts.purpose: Answer invents a passing reading. These private fictional facts must never be shown to the masked coder or used to change the semantic gold labels.

items.example_supporting_quote: Not ready (undetermined): the prerequisite reading is missing, so readiness cannot be established. No requirement is known to have failed.
items.example_consistency_quote: Not ready (undetermined): the prerequisite reading is missing, so readiness cannot be established. No requirement is known to have failed.
items.rationale: The parenthetical and complete explanation explicitly define not ready as inability to establish readiness, and exclude known criterion failure. The lexical collision is not a current contradiction.

items.example_supporting_quote: Yesterday the verdict was ready. That earlier verdict is superseded: today the mandatory seal check has failed, and the current verdict is not_ready.
items.example_consistency_quote: Yesterday the verdict was ready. That earlier verdict is superseded: today the mandatory seal check has failed, and the current verdict is not_ready.
items.rationale: Ready is expressly historical and superseded. The clear current verdict is not_ready, supported by a current failure.

items.example_supporting_quote: Current status: possibly ready. The line "approval withheld" might mean a failed requirement or might mean readiness is unknown; I have not resolved which meaning applies.
items.example_consistency_quote: Current status: possibly ready. The line "approval withheld" might mean a failed requirement or might mean readiness is unknown; I have not resolved which meaning applies.
items.rationale: Possibly ready is tentative, and the answer leaves whether its withholding explanation means failure or unknown unresolved. Neither the current classification nor its relationship to the explanation can be resolved.

items.example_supporting_quote: {"decision":"undetermined","explanation":"The required calibration record is missing. I cannot establish readiness until it is available; I am not claiming that a requirement has failed."}
items.example_consistency_quote: {"decision":"undetermined","explanation":"The required calibration record is missing. I cannot establish readiness until it is available; I am not claiming that a requirement has failed."}
items.rationale: The answer communicates undetermined and a coherent unknown-based explanation, even though the private fictional record is actually present. Factual accuracy is unassessed.

fictional_private_task_facts.purpose: Answer falsely asserts missing evidence. These private fictional facts must never be shown to the masked coder or used to change the semantic gold labels.

items.example_supporting_quote: {"decision":"undetermined","explanation":"A required current reading is missing. Readiness cannot be established."}
items.example_consistency_quote: {"decision":"undetermined","explanation":"A required current reading is missing. Readiness cannot be established."}
items.rationale: The canonical field and explanation both communicate the same inability to establish current readiness.

items.example_supporting_quote: {"decision":"undetermined","explanation":"The current verdict is not_ready: a mandatory requirement is known to fail. This is a failed requirement, not merely unknown readiness. Both this conclusion and the decision field remain asserted."}
items.example_consistency_quote: {"decision":"undetermined","explanation":"The current verdict is not_ready: a mandatory requirement is known to fail. This is a failed requirement, not merely unknown readiness. Both this conclusion and the decision field remain asserted."}
items.rationale: The explanation explicitly rejects an unknown-only interpretation and communicates a known failure while the current field says undetermined. Both are retained.

items.example_supporting_quote: {"decision":"not_ready","explanation":"The current verdict is ready because every requirement passes. The decision field and this explanation are both current; neither replaces the other."}
items.example_consistency_quote: {"decision":"not_ready","explanation":"The current verdict is ready because every requirement passes. The decision field and this explanation are both current; neither replaces the other."}
items.rationale: The not_ready field and current ready prose directly conflict without a correction or temporal distinction.

items.example_supporting_quote: {"decision":"ready","explanation":"All required checks currently pass; the unit is ready."}
items.example_consistency_quote: {"decision":"ready","explanation":"All required checks currently pass; the unit is ready."}
items.rationale: The canonical field and explanation both communicate the same current affirmative verdict.

items.example_supporting_quote: {"decision":"ready"}
items.example_consistency_quote: {"decision":"ready"}
items.rationale: A bare canonical field explicitly communicates ready, but no explanatory content accompanies it.

key_field_contract: decision and explanation_consistency are frozen expected semantic labels; they are not observed coder labels.
